With IID learning resolved and resources matched, independent blocks lose to random masks at primary delay32; the registered useful-gain prediction is falsified.

The final revised label is highly linearly readable in both frozen models, but the registered >=3pp model gap remains uncertain with a paired interval crossing zero and threshold.
The matched C0 d4 oracle-relative KL was only 0.012463, below the preregistered 0.07 headroom floor; the useful block effect was not discriminable despite matched resources and complete execution.
The preregistered K4 package exceeds the S68 sparse control latency cap in all nine timing comparisons while static resources match; task effect remains untested.
The frozen phase-reveal task is informative, but both strong single-GRU controls fail the preregistered IID32 learning gate at both learning rates; no RS4 effect is tested.
